ExportHelp.title: How to copy a deck from another site or app

moxfield.name: Moxfield
moxfield.steps: Open the deck, choose Export, copy the list as text (the Arena or plain-text option), and paste it below.

archidekt.name: Archidekt
archidekt.steps: Open the deck, choose Export from the deck menu, copy the text, and paste it below. Categories and tags are fine.

arena.name: MTG Arena
arena.steps: In Decks, select the deck and click Export. It is copied to your clipboard; paste it below.

mtgo.name: MTGO
mtgo.steps: Save the deck as a .dek or .txt file and open it here, or paste its text below.

cockatrice.name: Cockatrice
cockatrice.steps: Open a .cod or .txt file from your Cockatrice decks folder. To bring over every deck at once, use Import from Cockatrice on the Decks page.
